this is just me being nitpicky but not a huge fan of `push`ing stuff into an array and mutating it - can we just do it while instantiating something like this
```suggestion
const items = [
  ...(messageRole === "assistant"
    ? [{ label: "Add Tool Call", onClick: handlers.addToolCall }]
    : []),

  ...(messageRole === "user" && handlers.onAddText
    ? [{ label: "Add Text", onClick: handlers.onAddText }]
    : []),

  ...(messageRole === "user" && handlers.onAddImage
    ? [{ label: "Add Image", onClick: handlers.onAddImage }]
    : []),
];
```
nit: lets extract out the magic number here, 500, with the other 500 as a const
